'''Tring''' is one of the languages of Borneo, in [[Sarawak]], [[Malaysia]]. ''Ethnologue'' classifies the language as threatened.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/tgq|title=Tring|website=Ethnologue|language=en|access-date=2019-06-26}}</ref>
